title: Leftover directories
intro: Older releases could leave table directories that no table owns. Find them, then delete the old ones.
olderThanHelp: Days, 1 to 3,650. A directory with a newer file is kept.
partial: The search stopped at the time limit; Find again continues.
partialDelete: The deletion stopped at the time limit; Continue deletes the rest.
confirmBody: Their files are deleted for good; no table owns them. Recent directories are kept.
